title: Beztack Promotion metadata
description: Schema-versioned metadata for a Promotion from a Derived project back to the Template source. Promotion candidates are filtered by ownership and exclude Custom-owned Product domain changes by default per PRD-27. Promotion is opt-in via a PR label (the authoritative signal); Trusted Derived projects may use trusted automation, Community Derived projects enter as normal PRs or patches, both still require Beztack review per issue #33.

trustClass.description: Trust class granted by the Beztack-owned registry for this Derived project ID. Mirrors the structured `trust` block; engines prefer the registry over any project-side declaration.

trust.description: Structured Beztack-owned registry decision for this Derived project ID. Trust is granted by Beztack through its registry, not self-declared by Derived projects (ADR-0006).

trustClass.description: Trust class granted by the Beztack-owned registry (the canonical grant).

effectiveTrustClass.description: Trust class actually used for this run.

trustOverriddenByCaller.description: True when the caller passed --trust-class and the registry permitted a non-escalating override.

syncEngine.description: Sync engine that emitted this Promotion metadata. Versioned separately from the Template version per ADR-0006.

baselineRevision.description: Template revision the Derived project last accepted.

label.description: Promotion label applied to the source PR. The label is the authoritative opt-in signal per issue #33; the engine refuses to produce Promotion metadata without a label.

sourcePR.description: Primary source PR reference (URL or identifier) on the Derived project. The first link in `sourcePRs` is mirrored here for convenience.

sourcePRs.description: All source PR and issue references (URLs or identifiers) on the Derived project. Multiple links are accepted when one PR builds on or relates to others; the first entry is mirrored in `sourcePR`.

entryMode.description: How the source PR entered Beztack. Trusted Derived projects may use `trusted-automation` when Beztack-owned automation opens the PR; Community Derived projects may submit a `patch`. `normal-pr` is the default. Beztack review is still required in every case (ADR-0006).

candidates.description: Files eligible for Promotion. Owned by Template-owned paths or by unprotected parts of Mixed ownership.

skipped.description: Files intentionally excluded from Promotion, with the reason.

checks.description: Checks that ran in the source PR and in the engine. Engines record both their own validation checks and the upstream CI checks so reviewers can re-run them.

source.description: Where the check ran. `engine` checks were executed by the Beztack Sync engine (schema validation, ownership overlap, candidate filter, registry resolution, engine version compatibility). `upstream-pr-ci` checks were supplied from the source PR's CI run.

suggestedTemplateVersionImpact.description: Suggested Template version bump. Engines do not auto-publish; this is metadata for reviewers.

relatedPromotions.description: Other open Promotions that touch overlapping paths. Linked, not auto-deduplicated.
